q: What is a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model?
a: Instead of delivering a report and leaving, Innovsol engineers embed inside your team. They work in your codebase, your ticketing and your sprint rhythm, so what gets built fits how your organisation actually runs and reaches production.

q: How quickly can we go from idea to production?
a: Our delivery model targets production-ready AI in under 12 weeks. Timelines depend on scope, data readiness and integration complexity; the Discover phase exists to confirm a realistic plan before you commit.

A short, fixed-price engagement (about two weeks) that produces your AI roadmap: prioritised use cases, a technical blueprint and a business case. It requires no long-term commitment, so you can decide on the next phase with evidence.

q: Which industries do you work in?
a: Banking and financial services, manufacturing and operations, healthcare and life sciences, retail and e-commerce, telecom and media, insurance, GCCs and shared services, and high-growth startups. Each has a dedicated page describing typical use cases.

q: How do you handle security and confidentiality?
a: We design delivery around data isolation, role-based access and audit logging, and can work in private-cloud or on-premises environments. Client confidentiality is respected: we do not disclose customer names. See the Security page for details of what we do and what this website does.
